near_misses.safety_basis: The loaded Role object's organizationId is checked against the principal before the response; RoleController.update is deliberately excluded.
The returned User object passes through sanitizeUser, which removes credential and invitation-token fields; other response objects are outside this proof.
The read route checks assistants:view, the controller passes req.user.activeWorkspaceId, and getAssistantById queries by id plus workspaceId.
The owned Credential lookup uses id and workspaceId before decryption; only this method and branch are covered.
The wrapper rejects a missing workspaceId and getChatflowById includes it in the database predicate; Realtime execution is outside this proof.
